_comment: Pinned renderer stack for the paint harness (ADR-0003 Decision 5, issues #126, #127). Each file is a UMD/global browser build from the named npm tarball, vendored verbatim and never fetched at run time. Bump by re-running `npm pack <name>@<version>`, copying the build here, and recomputing sha256 — never by hand-editing the digest. Versions are chosen inside flint-chart 0.5.1's own peerDependencies range (chart.js ^4.0.0, echarts ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0, plotly.js ^2.0.0 || ^3.0.0) so the vendored renderer is one the assembler's output was actually designed against.
